bugs.description: INJECTED (declaration-renamed): Exported function renamed without updating its callers. `iter_route_contexts` renamed to `iter_route_contextsV2` in its declaration only; callers still use `iter_route_contexts`. Mutated fastapi/routing.py:1698: `def iter_route_contexts(` -> `def iter_route_contextsV2(`. The bug manifests in fastapi/openapi/utils.py:496: `for route_context in routing.iter_route_contexts(routes):`.
